articles.title: Relief distribution among flood victims in Greater Chittagong
articles.excerpt: A severe flood hit Chittagong in the first week of this month. Extensive areas in Chittagong, Cox's Bazar, and Bandarban were devastated, leaving thousands in urgent need of aid.
articles.content: A severe flood hit Chittagong in the first week of this month. Extensive areas in Chittagong, Cox's Bazar, and Bandarban were submerged under water. Our emergency rapid response team was dispatched immediately with dry food packages, clean drinking water, and essential hygiene kits to assist over 10,000 affected families across remote villages.

articles.title: 3rd Imams' Training Completed Successfully
articles.excerpt: The 3rd Imams' Training by the As-Sunnah Foundation has been successfully completed with the participation of selected Imams and community leaders nationwide.
articles.content: The 3rd Imams' Training program focused on modern community leadership, disaster management awareness, financial literacy, and social welfare advocacy. Over 150 Imams from various districts participated in this intensive 7-day residence workshop.

articles.title: Qurbani for All 2026 Project Completed
articles.excerpt: Breaking all past records to bring Eid smiles to the faces of the country's underprivileged and disaster-affected people, the social project reached 35+ districts.
articles.content: Our flagship Qurbani project successfully distributed fresh meat packages to over 85,000 underprivileged households during Eid-ul-Adha. Fresh meat was delivered directly to low-income families, orphanages, and disaster shelter camps.

articles.title: Community Health Camp in Sylhet Organized
articles.excerpt: A free health camp was organized in Sylhet, providing essential medical checkups and free prescription medicine to over 500 underprivileged families.
articles.content: Volunteer physicians and healthcare professionals conducted diagnostic health checkups, diabetes screenings, eye exams, and distributed vital medicines free of charge to rural communities in Sylhet.

articles.title: Youth Empowerment Workshop Held Successfully
articles.excerpt: The workshop focused on skill development and leadership training, empowering young participants from rural areas to initiate social impact initiatives.
articles.content: Youth leadership and vocational IT skills were taught to 120 aspiring young men and women. Hands-on mentorship sessions guided participants on creating sustainable micro-enterprises.

articles.title: Tree Plantation Drive Plants 50,000 Saplings
articles.excerpt: To combat climate vulnerability and coastal erosion, our volunteer network planted fruit-bearing and timber saplings across 12 coastal sub-districts.
articles.content: Local school students, community elders, and green activists joined hands to plant mangrove and shade saplings along embankments, protecting riverbanks and fostering environmental sustainability.

articles.title: Clean Water Tube-Well Project Phase 4 Completed
articles.excerpt: Installation of 80 deep tube-wells brings pure, safe drinking water to salinity-affected coastal villages in Satkhira and Khulna.
articles.content: Clean drinking water access has been restored to over 24,000 villagers where arsenic contamination and high salinity previously caused severe waterborne illnesses.

articles.title: Winter Blanket Drive Prepares Aid for 20,000 Families
articles.excerpt: High-density thermal blankets and warm winter clothing sets are being procured for cold-wave vulnerable northern districts.
articles.content: Preparations are underway to reach elderly citizens, day laborers, and children in northern hilly and flood-plain regions before the onset of extreme winter cold waves.

articles.title: Emergency Blood Donation Camp Collects 300 Bags
articles.excerpt: Volunteers and university students gathered to donate blood for thalassemia patients and emergency surgical cases at Central Red Cross Center.
articles.content: A day-long blood donation drive successfully registered 450 donors and collected 300 blood bags that were supplied directly to major public hospitals.
